item.title: Progress 2026: Expanding reach
item.description: Hormel Institute’s influence will be spread further as it incorporates education goals into MiBC development.

item.title: Hulne: Invest in your kid, not just their sports career
item.description: Youth sports now demand big money and time, but that investment won't guarantee a scholarship or stardom. Focus on your child's joy and growth, not a future career.

item.title: Dynamic duo: Packer backcourt shines in first playoff win since 2023
item.description: Hebrink and Severin combine for 54 points as Austin tops Winona 86-68 for its first playoff win since 2023, setting up Section 1AAA semifinal vs. Stewartville.

item.title: Larry David Kramer
item.description: Larry David Kramer Died February 25, 2026. Services pending.

item.title: Man who skipped sentencing for sexual assault of minor, back in jail and charged for failing to appear
item.description: Convicted Austin man Charles Wesley Jones is back in Mower County jail, charged with felony failure to appear after skipping his 2025 sentencing for sexually assaulting a child under 13.

item.title: Randall Edwin Qualey
item.description: Randall Edwin Qualey, passed away peacefully at his home on Monday, January 12, 2026, of natural causes, due to a massive heart attack in June 2025.

item.title: Ramona (Jech) Defrang
item.description: We celebrate the beautiful life of our dear mother and sister, Ramona (Jech) Defrang, who passed away on February 17, 2026.

item.title: Austin Ollie's opens as franchise's first Minnesota store
item.description: Discount retailer Ollie’s opens its first Minnesota store in Austin, as it looks to create more of a footprint in the state.

item.title: The SPAM Brand, Bachan’s serve up crave-worthy, limited-edition Japanese barbecue flavor
item.description: SPAM and Bachan's debut limited-edition Japanese Barbecue Sauce flavored SPAM, hitting Walmart stores nationwide Saturday in 12-ounce cans for about $4, rooted in Asian American food culture.

item.title: Vikings' bid for state comes up one shot short in Section 1A title game loss
item.description: Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy girls led most of the way but fell 64-62 to New Richland-HEG in the Section 1A title game, missing a potential game-winning three at the buzzer.
